fields.step1_body:
"Managed accounts" doesn't say what you fixed.
Buyers pay for the fix, not the title.
So translate your résumé, line by line.
The free Skill Finder does the first pass.
fields.step2_body:
Choose the duty you did for years.
Ask: what went wrong when I was out?
That's the problem you solved.
Now find who else has it.
fields.step3_body:
Not your old employer. Smaller places.
A shop, a clinic, a brand-new manager.
Ask Claude who else fights this problem.
Then pick the buyer you understand best.
fields.step4_body:
"I help [who] fix [problem]."
One sentence. No title, no jargon.
Read it to a friend and watch their face.
"I know someone" means you're close.
fields.cta_subtext: Comment {o:SKILLS} and I'll DM you my free Skill Finder: 12 questions, then AI names your 3 most sellable skills.
